name: preleaf
description: Local Overleaf-like LaTeX report space. Web UI + Docker compilation.

scripts.setup: npm install && npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix app install
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,app -c blue,green "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix app run dev"
scripts.build:app: npm --prefix app install && npm --prefix app run build
scripts.build: npm run build:server && npm run build:app
